title: Taken unknowingly to the hangar building with an EG&G escort

tellings.quote: >> Um, my EGNG escort knew I was going to uh that building that day, but um

plain: A NASA doctor named Greg Rogers says he was taken, without knowing where he was going, to the hangar building where he says he saw a UFO, at a base he does not name. He tells Michels that his escort from EG&G, a contractor that staffed secret government sites, 'knew I was going to that building that day' even though he himself did not.
